description: This PHP abstract class 'NormalizableDTO' provides methods to normalize data arrays for report display. It includes abstract methods for converting objects to arrays and retrieving a mapping of fields to getter methods, along with protected helper methods for normalization and method calling on data items.

classes.name: NormalizableDTO
classes.description: An abstract class designed for normalizing data transfer objects within the report display context.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Abstract method to convert the object to an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Abstract method to return a map of fields to getter methods.

methods.name: normalizeArray
methods.description: Normalizes an iterable dataset into a structured array based on specified fields and getter mappings.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Calls getter methods on a data item, supporting nested getter sequences for complex retrieval.
